0022600092.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Trail Blazers hosting the Phoenix Suns in Portland's first game of the year. Portland is without Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), while Phoenix is missing Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The Trail Blazers lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, but they won the most recent meeting 92-77 in Phoenix on February 22, 2026.
